about: The copy golden set (P50): briefs for the SYNTHETIC demo client 'synthdemo' (Harbourline Ferries, an invented ferry operator) only - no client material. Each case says what a first draft must carry, deterministically: the approved facts it is about, the banned terms it must not use, a call to action that carries the brief's action, and the platform limits. tools/copy-eval.mjs scores drafts against it; tests/copy-eval-test.mjs runs it on the mocked engine.

kit.name: Harbourline Ferries - SYNTHETIC DEMO CLIENT
kit.voice: Plain, warm and local. Short sentences. No exclamation marks.
kit.rules: No exclamation marks. Avoid: world-class, stakeholders.
